metadata.title: Rivora — Full-Stack Development & VPS Deployment
metadata.description: Rivora builds custom web applications, deploys them to production VPS, and delivers ready-to-use digital products. Full-stack development for businesses worldwide.
metadata.keywords: full stack development, web development, VPS deployment, custom software, SaaS, Rivora

hero.title: Digital Products That Drive Real Impact
hero.subtitle: Full-stack development, production deployment, and ongoing support — from one developer you can trust.

stats.title: A solo developer partner focused on shipping quality software and keeping it running in production.
stats.projectsDesc: Custom systems built for real businesses
stats.deployDesc: VPS deployment included with every project

fullstack.title: Full-Stack Development
fullstack.description: Modern web apps with React, Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. Clean architecture, tested code, and scalable design.

deployment.title: VPS Deployment
deployment.description: I deploy your project to a VPS — Docker, Nginx, SSL, monitoring. Your app live, secure, and maintained.

maintenance.title: Maintenance & Support
maintenance.description: Updates, bug fixes, performance tuning, and feature iterations. Your product stays healthy after launch.

consulting.title: Technical Consulting
consulting.description: Architecture reviews, stack decisions, and roadmap planning before you write a single line of code.

api.title: API & Integrations
api.description: REST and GraphQL APIs, third-party integrations, payment gateways, and automation workflows.

products.title: Ready-Made Products
products.description: Pre-built systems you can purchase outright or subscribe to monthly. Deployed and configured for you.

portfolio.label: Portfolio
portfolio.title: Client Work
portfolio.subtitle: Private systems built under NDA. Showcased here to demonstrate scope and quality — details anonymized.

booking.title: Booking & Scheduling System
booking.description: Multi-location appointment platform with calendar sync, notifications, and admin dashboard.

dashboard.title: Analytics Dashboard
dashboard.description: Real-time KPI dashboard for a logistics company. Data pipelines, charts, and role-based access.

crm.title: Custom CRM
crm.description: Sales pipeline, client management, and automated follow-ups for a B2B services firm.

products.label: Products

admin.title: Admin Panel Template
